purpose: Neutral deterministic comparison of two valid Estate Audit Manifests, identifying exactly which reviewed-app identity dimensions changed.
rules: Both input manifests must pass their own manifestSha256 verification before comparison.
Inputs must be Estate Audit Manifest v1 artifacts.
Apps are classified as added, removed, changed or unchanged.
Changed apps list each changed dimension with exact before and after values.
Output ordering is deterministic by appId and dimension name.
The diff reports before/after asOf and manifest hashes.
The diff makes no judgement about whether a change is good, bad, expected, risky or safe.
The diff mutates nothing and grants no workflow authority.
nonClaims: A changed app is not necessarily less secure.
An unchanged app is not guaranteed secure.
The diff explains recorded manifest dimensions only; deeper cause analysis requires the corresponding per-app audit exports and underlying evidence.
